subject: Offline review of the feature 015 benchmark packages for the ST CRC and SPI LL drivers (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0, FROZEN)
decision: The owner reviewed the two READY_FOR_OFFLINE_REVIEW packages below and approved them. The approval is bound to each sealed archive by its SHA-256; any other archive of these work orders is not covered.
not_changed: No safety approval, ASPICE/ISO 26262 compliance or certification claim; the delivered ST code is unchanged (FROZEN); the signed SSA-STB-001/TAA-STB-001 and their open findings stand; the other three benchmark drivers (USART, GPIO, TIM) are not covered.
